summary: Northwest Natural Holding Co filed an 8-K reporting the issuance and sale of $120 million aggregate principal amount of senior notes in three series (Series E, F, G) via a note purchase agreement with institutional investors. Terms: Series E $50M at 5.35% due 2031, Series F $10M at 5.35% due 2031, Series G $60M at 5.83% due 2036. Proceeds used for general corporate purposes and debt repayment. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
